name: codex-semantic-memory
description: Local semantic memory for Codex. Indexes the project with LogosDB structure-aware chunking, recalls relevant context, and stores turn records on disk.

interface.longDescription: Indexes a project with LogosDB and recalls it in later Codex sessions. Code is split on function and class boundaries, Markdown on headings, and prose on paragraphs. Data stays on disk. Requires Node.js and logosdb-mcp-server 1.4.7.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we decided about this project.
Re-index this repository into local memory.
